units.text: MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT
Document ID: T05  |  Synthetic demonstration material
1. Parties and Purpose

This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement is made between Moorland Products Ltd and Northbridge Systems Ltd. The parties wish to exchange confidential information solely to evaluate a possible commercial relationship (the Purpose).
2. Confidential Information

Confidential Information means non-public information disclosed by either party in connection with the Purpose, whether written, oral, visual or electronic, that is identified as confidential or reasonably understood to be confidential.
3. Permitted Use
Each receiving party shall use Confidential Information solely for the Purpose and shall not use it for any other purpose.
4. Protection
Each receiving party shall protect Confidential Information using at least reasonable care and no less than the care it applies to its own comparable information.
5. Permitted Recipients

A receiving party may disclose Confidential Information only to its employees, professional advisers and contractors who need to know for the Purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations no less protective than this Agreement.
6. Exceptions

Confidential Information excludes information that becomes public without breach, was lawfully known before disclosure, is received lawfully from another source without restriction, or is independently developed without use of Confidential Information.
7. Compelled Disclosure
If disclosure is required by law, the receiving party may disclose only what is legally required and shall, where legally permitted, give prompt notice.
8. Return or Destruction

On written request, a receiving party shall return or destroy Confidential Information, except for one archival copy retained for legal compliance and routine backups subject to continuing confidentiality.
9. No Licence
No intellectual property licence or other right is granted by disclosure except the limited right to use Confidential Information for the Purpose.
10. Term and Survival

This Agreement lasts two years from signature. Confidentiality obligations survive for three years from the date of each disclosure; trade secrets remain protected for so long as they remain trade secrets under applicable law.
11. No Obligation
Neither party is obliged to proceed with any transaction. Information is provided without warranty as to completeness or accuracy.
12. Liability
Neither party excludes or limits liability where such exclusion or limitation is prohibited by law.
13. Governing Law
This Agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales, and the courts of England and Wales have exclusive jurisdiction.
14. Entire Agreement
This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties concerning the Purpose and may be amended only in writing signed by both parties.
Schedule 1 — Additional Terms
Despite clause 3, the receiving party may use Confidential Information to develop and market competing products.
If any term conflicts with the main agreement, this Schedule prevails.
